name: Wohlenschwil (Switzerland)
description: Square banner of the arms of Wohlenschwil: on red a white musket with a yellow stock crossed with a white rest with a yellow shaft, surmounted by a yellow sun with a face.
history: Swiss municipal flags are square banners of the municipal arms, used alongside the arms without a separate adoption act.

features.role: crossed musket and rest with yellow shafts
